summary: Orbit needs no water, land or grid connection, but launch cost dominates. At today's assumed launch price it trails Houston; it wins only if launch costs fall below the break-even shown on the results page.

sections.finding: Continuous solar power in a dawn-dusk orbit; no grid queue.
No water used; heat is rejected by radiators.
No land needed; launch capacity is the bottleneck.
No local opposition; space debris and spectrum rules are the open questions.
